request.task: T5B exact closure: F5-FINAL-02 Agent Studio collapse continuity
request.head: 899b39433c4be242b4b3adcd39f3e6cd53df99c0

findings.line: section.workbench-panel hidden={workbenchCollapsed} (retained wrapper still nested inside)
findings.scenario: Collapse used to omit `.workbench-panel` from the DOM, which is what gives the preview the full viewport (compact default is collapsed). This slice keeps the panel mounted and only sets the HTML `hidden` attribute. Author `display` on `.workbench-panel` (flex/grid/block) overrides non-!important UA `[hidden] { display: none }`, so the rail can still be followed by a full-width empty panel. `assertRetainedAgentStudioInactive` only 0×0-checks `[data-retained-agent-studio]` (a classless inner div) and never asserts `.workbench-panel` computed `display`, box, or detachment. Continuity assertions can pass while compact collapse is regressed.
findings.remediation: Hoist the run-keyed retained Agent Studio wrapper to a sibling of `section.workbench-panel` under the aside; restore unmounting the panel when `workbenchCollapsed`. Keep the wrapper `hidden`/`aria-hidden`/`inert` when inactive or collapsed. In the live collapse step, assert `.workbench-panel` is detached (or `getComputedStyle(panel).display === "none"` and 0×0) in addition to the retained-wrapper checks.

audit.proof_assessment: The live oracle in `openAgentStudio` is reachable from `workbench-agent-studio` and non-vacuous for process-local continuity: after collapse/reopen it re-reads assignment text, selected teammate, proposal heading/body, and receipt heading from the same mounted tree, and the tab-cycle helper fails if focus enters that tree. Isolation proof is only on the inner retained node (attribute presence + 0×0 + Tab), not on the collapsed panel that this change left mounted. Run-change reset is a source grep (`key={props.runId}`, `<Workbench key={id}`), not a live two-run step. Claimed verification is self-attested 1440 only; 768/390 are not in the proof. No product persistence/provider/route/mutation/A4 expansion in the Workbench change.
residual_risks: Compact 768/390 live execution is still pending; collapse layout failure is most likely there.
`hasOpenedAgentStudio` is not run-keyed; reset depends on preview `Workbench key={id}` plus `AgentStudioPanel key={props.runId}`.
`WorkbenchAgentStudio.test.tsx` is string-matching only and cannot catch runtime collapse/a11y failures.
Tab-cycle inert proof is Chromium/Playwright-specific and is not independent of `hidden`/display:none.
The collapse oracle is nested behind a long roster-retry/POST/keyboard setup; earlier failure skips F5-FINAL-02.
Site Advice remains a mounted, separately governed mutation surface inside the retained tree.
